sloka: चित्राणि अत्र बहूनि स्युः मूलानि च फलनि च ।तत्र अपि एष विशेषेण विधिः हि भविता ध्रुवम् ॥१-१०-२७॥
transliteration: citrāṇi atra bahūni syuḥ mūlāni ca phalani ca ।tatra api eṣa viśeṣeṇa vidhiḥ hi bhavitā dhruvam ॥1-10-27॥

translations.english: Having heard their words pleasing to the mind, he agreed to go with them. And the women took him away.
